description_en: Queries a list of asset groups that are managed by a bastion host
description_zh: 获取指定堡垒机下的资产组列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-host-groups --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListHostGroups

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462953.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462953.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host in which you want to query the host group.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page.

We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时每页显示的数据最大条数。pagesize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，pagesize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议pagesize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the host group that you want to query. Only exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的资产组名称，不支持模糊查询，只支持精确查询
parameters.name: host_group_name

Comment.description_en: The remarks of the asset group

HostGroupName.description_en: The name of the asset group

MemberCount.description_en: The number of hosts in the asset group

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of asset groups returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的资产组总数量
